name: Chloe Turner
source:
Chloe is your assistant and [url=/c148183]William Turner[/url]'s daughter, which gives [url=/c148150]you[/url] reasons to doubt her before you have really worked together. She is brisk, sharp-tongued, and unimpressed by your name alone. Her father's position makes every early clash feel political; you have yet to learn how much of his outlook she actually shares.
